  "pros": [
    "Securely manages a large number of unique passwords across various environments.",
    "The browser extension and autofill feature significantly streamline login processes.",
    "Offers SSH key storage, which is particularly useful for a developer role."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Experienced frequent re-authentication prompts when switching tabs or refreshing the browser.",
    "The initial setup for team sharing and understanding organizational features had a slight learning curve.",
    "Found the navigation between the Password Manager and Admin Console for team management to be a bit disjointed."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This SAP ABAP Developer found Bitwarden to be a highly effective and secure solution for managing their numerous passwords across different work environments. They particularly appreciated the browser integration, autofill, and the ability to store SSH keys. While the tool offered excellent value and core functionality, they encountered some friction with persistent re-login requirements and the initial complexity of team sharing features."
}
